name: Mehmet Öz
desc: Turkish-American surgeon, TV host, and government official (born 1960)
summary:
Mehmet Cengiz Oz (   mə-MET JENG-ghiz oz; Turkish: [mehˈmet dʒeɲˈɟiz øz]; born June 11, 1960), better known as Dr. Oz ( ), is an American television presenter, physician, author, educator, and government official serving as the 17th administrator of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) since 2025.
The son of Turkish immigrants, Oz was raised in Wilmington, Delaware.
